The Approach

What is Facial
Harmonisation?


Facial harmonisation is a modern, premium aesthetic approach that enhances your face through balance, proportion and structure. Instead of treating one feature in isolation, we assess your facial profile and design a plan that supports your unique anatomy.

At Délavoy, we assess facial proportions, symmetry, profile balance, and ageing patterns before any treatment is performed.

Your dermal filler (2ml or 4ml) is allocated strategically based on your goals and what will create the most flattering, natural looking result. The volume does not automatically cover every area. We tailor placement for maximum impact.
